## Goal

Agent-authored server code with full capability, isolated for stability: durable action runs, live data and artifact state from the server.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| RT-03 | Artifact server code runs in a worker process per active artifact version (normally one per artifact), started lazily, evicted after idle, restarted with backoff and parked after repeated crashes | I | Worker per active version starts on first call, evicts after idle, restarts with backoff, parks after repeated crashes (integration) |
| RT-04 | A crash, hang or memory blow-up in one artifact leaves the gateway and other artifacts working; the failure is reported with an actionable message | I | Crash, OOM and busy-loop fixtures in one artifact; sibling artifact and gateway keep serving; viewer sees actionable message |
| RT-08 | Daemon, worker and port lifecycles follow D62: idle exit after 30 minutes unless needed, `mostra daemon install` for a login service, 1 GiB heap and 10 s watchdog defaults, and port leases reused across restarts | I | Lifecycle tests for daemon idle exit (with and without pending work), `daemon install` units generated, heap and watchdog limits applied, port leases reused after restart |
| AC-01 | **Invariant.** Agent-authored server functions run with full capability, with no capability or content restriction | I | Fixture action reads a file, spawns a process and calls the network with no Mostra restriction (integration) |
| AC-02 | Each invocation is a durable action run with streamed progress, log, partial and final events; runs outlive the tab and can be re-attached | I, B | Run streams progress, log and partial results; survives tab reload and re-attaches; final event recorded |
| AC-03 | A client-generated idempotency key de-duplicates invocations; a double click runs once | I, B | Double click and two tabs with an explicit key send once to a counting fake server |
| AC-04 | Cancellation reaches the action through an AbortSignal | I | Cancel reaches the action's AbortSignal; run ends cancelled |
| AC-05 | Actions can emit host events and signals | C | emit() and signal() from an action reach a subscribed host with causation (conformance) |
| AC-06 | Secrets used by actions are named, scoped to an artifact or the home, stored owner-only or supplied by the host's secrets port, and never appear in source, versions, exports, logs, events, diagnostics or screenshots | I | Secrets set by name, resolved by home store and by port; grep tests over logs, events, exports, diagnostics and screenshots find no value |
| AC-07 | Live data: loaders with polling, streams and file watching; push from CLI/SDK; one `useLive` hook; data never rides HMR channels | I, B | load, refresh, watch, stream and push all update useLive; live data never uses HMR channels (no Vite client in versions) |
| LL-04 | Live updates are ephemeral notifications over a persisted latest value and optional ring buffer; producers run while viewed or subscribed, or always with `always: true` | I | Live updates produce no durable events; producer lifecycle with viewers, subscriptions and always:true; ring buffer bounded |
| RS-01 | The five seams in D19 exist and are covered by tests in v1 | M | One test per D19 seam (mode field, use server contract and serializer, AsyncLocalStorage context, use client runtime, RenderMode) |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- the worker process with the IPC call path and AsyncLocalStorage context;
- the serializer with its React-conformance suite;
- plain calls and durable action runs with keys, join, cancel, the `interrupted` reason and capped logs;
- `@mostra/server` (secrets with the home store and port, signals, `emit`, `state`);
- live sources (`load`, `refresh`, `watch`, `stream`, `always`, ring) and pushes;
- `useAction` and `useLive`;
- the watchdog, backoff, parking, eviction and port-lease lifecycles;
- tests for the five RSC seams.

Design detail for this package:

- Worker: loads the version's server bundle, executes calls inside AsyncLocalStorage, never sees cookies or tokens; WorkerLauncher as the seam.
- Serializer with a conformance suite mirroring React's documented Server Function types plus AsyncIterable.
- Runs: recorded before start, keys unique per artifact and action, join semantics, cancel, `interrupted` on crash, 1 MB log cap.
- Live sources: producers per D56/D63 with persisted latest value, ring buffer, pushes; ephemeral delivery.
- Lifecycle: watchdog, heap limit, idle eviction, backoff, parking; port leases for artifacts with server code.
- Five RSC seam tests (RS-01).

## Acceptance evidence

- a crash, an OOM and a hang in one artifact leave the gateway and a sibling serving;
- a double click sends once (a counting fake mail server);
- a run survives a tab reload and re-attaches;
- an `AbortSignal` is observed;
- secrets are absent from logs, events and exports (grep tests);
- live updates flow without durable events;
- a seam test per D19 seam.

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Effects of a run killed mid-flight: document provider idempotency keys in the Skill references.
